_comment: Illustrative GET /api/issues/{id} object for Paperclip 2026.1005.0 with real field names and placeholder values only. No live ids or text. Classes: BASELINE (status, priority, updatedAt: compared directly), OWN (hashed in full), GOAL (hashed unless inherited from the project), RELATION (hashed as sorted ids), DOCUMENT (hashed as sorted (key, id, latestRevisionId, latestRevisionNumber)), PROJECTION (dropped), BOARD_SIDE_EFFECT (dropped: written by Paperclip itself on an adoptable change). Re-derive on every Paperclip upgrade.
board_side_effect_note: services/issues.js L7050-7070, L7213-7247: a priority-only or backlog/todo update writes updatedAt and recomputes goalId (resolveNextIssueGoalId; unchanged unless the project goal changed, covered by GOAL); blocked-only columns and execution columns are not written for such a change. statusVersion IS written: @paperclipai/db dist/migrations/0227_modern_pandemic.sql L146-158 installs paperclip_issue_status_version_trigger (BEFORE UPDATE OF "status" ON issues), which adds 1 whenever status IS DISTINCT FROM the old status, whoever makes the change; the service adds 1 on an assignee change or a blocked reassert (services/issues.js L7237, L7246). Corrected 2026-11-09: the plan 100 read stopped at the service layer and missed the trigger; a live backlog->todo move took statusVersion 0->1. So the list is [statusVersion]. A priority-only update leaves it alone.
